paragraphs.text: Read-only task overview view for DeepSeek Harness: rounds, facts, verification and a bounded history
, one screen next to the conversation.
# dsh-vantage

A read-only **task overview** view for DeepSeek Harness. It sits next to the
conversation and answer
s one question: where does this task actually stand?

Nothing in this view schedules, stops, or completes work. It observes session
events that already ha

ppened and renders them: the current round's work topics,
the evidence behind each one, and a bounde
d history of earlier rounds.
## Preview
| Live session | Saved session | Saved history |

Captured from a real installed profile: the live session is a fresh turn, the
saved sessions are exi
sting archives opened without turning the switch on.

The last image below is the same saved session opened inside the user's own
running Harness window (
`localhost:62741`), not a fixture:

A saved round keeps its own reading position: the pager stays at the top while
the detail scrolls, a
nd going back returns to the same place in the history list.
## What it shows

- **One to three work topics** — what changed, what is still being checked, what
blocks the task. A

topic is a unit of work, never a tool name, and never a
test/lint/build list.
- **Evidence** — each

topic expands to its own explanation and the facts behind
it: plan, report, or observation. Raw comm

and output stays collapsed inside
that row and is fetched only when opened.
- **Verification** — whe

ther the closing check passed, failed, or is still open.
A passing check is evidence, not a topic.
-

**History** — earlier rounds that ended with a real reply, newest first. The
list and the round det

ail never appear at the same time. Inside a round, the
pager and the ←/→ keys move one round at a ti

me; the newest saved round turns
the forward step into 「回到本轮」.
- **Saved sessions** — a session that

is no longer live opens read-only: its
last round, delivered items, and history come from the saved

log, and the
switch is hidden so viewing it cannot start recording or a model call.
- **Per-session

switch** — off by default. While it is off the plugin neither
folds events, nor builds snapshots, n

or sends anything to a model. Turning it
on starts recording from that moment; saved rounds stay rea

to a model. Turning it
on starts recording from that moment; saved rounds stay readable in history.

The overview is a reading surface, so the message composer stays out of the way:
while this view is

mounted the plugin hides the composer seat, and it returns the
moment you switch back to the convers

ation. That is a scoped attribute plus one
CSS rule on the host's own seat, not a DOM rewrite — the

host keeps ownership of
its chrome.
### When the first read fails

The view reads one `GET /snapshot` when it mounts and then polls. A cold plugin
load, a Host route t

hat is still mounting, or a dropped request used to leave the
panel on 「正在读取」 until someone pressed

the retry button. The client now retries
by itself: four attempts at 400 ms, 1.6 s, 3.6 s and 6.4 s,

reset on the first
success and on a session switch, and cleaned up when the view unmounts. After th

e
fourth failure it stays on the manual retry state instead of spinning forever.

Controls follow the prototype's text language rather than browser defaults: one
32 px-tall switch wi

th a 30×18 track and a 12 px knob, text links with a 32 px
hit area, one 2 px focus ring from `--dsw

-focus-ring-*`, and no filled pill
buttons. The panel takes its colors from host `--dsw-*` tokens, s

o light, dark
and narrow layouts need no separate rules.

A round is a product-level unit, not a turn or a step. A reply closes a round, but
"replied" never m

eans "verified". An empty verification list reads 「尚未明确」 and
never passes by default.
## Install

The plugin is a single package; a Host half (`index.js`) folds session events and
serves seven exact

routes, and a client half (`client.js`) registers the `vantage`
view in the conversation's view swi

s, and a client half (`client.js`) registers the `vantage`
view in the conversation's view switcher.

Install the folder with the plugin manager (`install_bundle`), which links it
into your profile and

asks Cordis to apply its bundle patch. Applying the patch
inserts one id, `dsh-vantage`; no existing

entry is modified. The view appears
after the next plugin reload — press the refresh button, or res

. The view appears
after the next plugin reload — press the refresh button, or restart the app once.

To wire it by hand, add the checkout to your profile's `dependencies` and put
`dsh-vantage` at the e
nd of `dsh.profile.bundles`.
Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3`.
## Configuration
All options are optional. The defaults are deliberately quiet.
| key | default | meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | serve snapshots at all; the per-session switch still starts off |
| `summary.

enabled` | `true` | allow model summaries for sessions whose switch is on |
| `summary.cadenceMs` |

`180000` | minimum gap between summaries, floored at 60 s |
| `summary.firstEligibleMs` | `60000` |

earliest first summary after a round starts |
| `summary.maxInputTokens` | `2400` | cap on the whole

request, system prompt included |
| `summary.maxOutputTokens` | `400` | cap on the answer |
| `summ

ary.maxTopics` | `3` | topics a summary may return |
| `summary.requestDeadlineMs` | `25000` | hard

deadline for one summariser call |
| `summary.provider` | `""` | model provider; empty uses the sess

ion default |
| `summary.model` | `""` | model name; empty uses the session default |

Without a model configured, the view degrades to a factual summary built from the
folded facts. A fa

iled summary keeps the last valid one and its real update time;
it never falls back to a checklist o

y keeps the last valid one and its real update time;
it never falls back to a checklist of commands.
## Wire

The Host serves four `GET` reads and three `POST` calls under
`/api/dsh-vantage`: `snapshot`, `histo

ry`, `round`, `evidence`; then
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

Everything is local. The plugin stores at most 20 rounds per session and 200
rounds globally, never

copies the full trajectory, and sends the summariser only
a bounded fact pack — no credentials, envi

ronment variables, or replay data. The
view never takes part in scheduling or completion decisions,

and a disabled
session causes no model call and no stored round.
